game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against frozen golems.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against frozen golems. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the spells value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the beacon fire using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the beacon fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Cold Larder'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Cold Larder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 21.
